# Hey there! I’m Carina Grady.

I’m a literary activist interested in what it means to be human in a strange (brave?) new world. I began my career as an engineer, publishing research long before any of my poems made it into print. Now, I organize literary spaces, facilitate writing communities, teach dance as connection, and write poetry and fiction examining extractive capitalism, technological alienation, and an emerging technofeudalism. This site is a reflection of everything I’m passionate about; I love a good deep-dive into analytics just as much as I love a lively dance floor or a compelling poem. Take a look around, and if something sparks an idea, let's connect!

---

This site is built entirely with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and R markdown!
View the source code on [GitHub](https://github.com/caringrad/carinagrady.github.io).
